verdict.rationale: Importing mail history and contacts is a fair question for an email provider, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no migration or import feature for messages or contacts. IMAP/SMTP client connectivity lets users connect Outlook or Thunderbird to an AgentMail inbox, but using that to move old mail would be a user-side workaround, not a documented import capability.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can import my complete mail history and contacts from my old provider or client
